can_heal.instructions: In a11y_diff, '-' lines are the old page and '+' lines the new page. Is there a '+' line that is a working replacement for the control the test was looking for: same kind of control, new name or new position?

criteria.true: a '+' line shows the same kind of control under a different name or in a different place
criteria.false: the control only disappeared (a '-' line with no replacement), or it reappears marked [disabled], or the diff shows no change, or the page is an error page or did not load

halt_reason.instructions: A browser end-to-end test failed. Who needs to act on it?

criteria.developer: the app now behaves wrongly: a wrong value, a server error, missing data or a broken flow
criteria.platform: the environment failed: server unreachable, network or DNS error, disk full, browser crash, or it passed on retry
criteria.test_author: the test is wrong: a typo in the locator, a wrong fixture or expectation, an ambiguous locator or invalid input
